sentences.text: S / o Chand Mohammad, Aged About 68 Years,

Saddam Hussain S/o Sarajudeen, Aged About 30 Years,
 Police Station Rayla, Dist. Bhilwara.
 (Presently Lodged In Dist. Jail, Bhilwara).
 ----Petitioners  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. N.K. Gurjar For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, P.P.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MADAN GOPAL VYAS Order 22/03/2023

The petitioners have been arrested in connection with FIR No.210/2022 of Police Station Rayala, District Bhilwara for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468,
471, 120-B and 201 IPC.

They have preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners have falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that co-accused viz., Kailash Chandra and Chotulal have already been enlarged on bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 21.03.2023.
The accused-petitioners are in judicial custody since long and the trial of the case will take long [2023/RJJD/007327] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-3003/2023] time.
Therefore, it is prayed that the accused-petitioners may be enlarged on bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioners Sarajudeen vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/007327) on 22 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30607131/
1 under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioners, (1) Sarajudeen S/o Chand Mohammad, and (2) Saddam Hussain S/o Sarajudeen shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.210/2022 of Police Station Rayala, District Bhilwara provided each of them executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for their appearance before that Court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MADAN GOPAL VYAS),J 318-Bharti/-
